decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing line had its own page in both observed years, which shows sustained investment and visible commitment that management would not write off.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's announced direction, and the line gained its own page in 2019, so the commitment is growing.

Although it dropped from its own page to a mention in 2019, it was presented as a flagship, and dropping it would expose that public commitment as a mistake, so weak visibility would be read as temporary.
It was only mentioned, which implies modest visible investment, but it fits the low-profile, integrated direction and complements the floor-level shower systems, so it is retained.
The backflow-protected cellar drain was publicly launched as a Dallmer development and featured on the home page, a strong visible commitment that management would persist with.
This peripheral air-admittance valve has little visible investment and is the easiest to drop, but it rounds out the drainage portfolio at low cost, so a narrow keep is favored.
